content.text: SchedulePlayoffsBAL 2026League PassGamesWatchNewsStatsStandingsTeamsPlayersNBA PlayFantasyStoreTicketsAffiliates Special Spectrum SportsNet Offer Back for the 2025-26 season, eligible Spectrum Internet + Mobile customers can now watch all Lakers games, produced by Spectrum SportsNet, in-market both live and on demand with Spectrum SportsNet+ (subject to national exclusivities). Click SIGN IN below and use your Spectrum username and password to start watching Spectrum SportsNet+. Sign In To start watching on your Xumo Stream Box and other connected TV devices: Download the NBA app and follow Los Angeles Lakers Click the Account icon in the navigation Click Sign in with your TV Provider Choose Spectrum and sign in with your Spectrum username and password Find and click on a Lakers game or click SportsNet+ in the navigation to start watching To start watching on your mobile device: Download the NBA app and follow Los Angeles Lakers Tap the Account icon and select Subscriptions under My Account Tap Sign In and then tap Select TV Provider Choose Spectrum and sign in with your Spectrum username and password Find and tap on a Lakers game or find the Lakers team page to start watching Your Privacy ChoicesWe use cookies and other tracking technologies on our online services. Through these technologies, we and certain third parties may collect information about your interactions with our online services to enhance the browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and personalize content and ads. By using our online services, you confirm your agreement to the use of these technologies. See our Cookie Policy for more details. By using our online services, you agree to our Terms of Use and acknowledge our Privacy Policy.
